title: Joyed feeds
body:
JoyedFeeds – Instant Hunger Refill for Players & Staff

JoyedFeeds is a simple, no-fuss plugin that lets players or staff instantly refill hunger bars. Perfect for survival, events, or admin support, it fits right into any server setup.

 Features:
	•	/feed – Instantly restores your hunger and saturation
	•	/feed [username] – Feed others with a single command (admin command)
	•	Permissions:
	•	joyedfeeds.feed – Access to /feed for yourself
	•	joyedfeeds.feed.others – Access to /feed [username] for others

Lightweight, lag-free, and built for reliability — keep your players full and focused with JoyedFeeds!
